Jazeera Airways signs MoU with Kuwait's Association of Retired Officers . Image Courtesy: Jazeera Airways

To further strengthen its cooperation and commitment to supporting the Association’s members and their families

Press Release

Kuwait: Jazeera Airways represented by Naser Alobaid, Chief Executive Government Relations and Chief Executive Officer – T5, signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Kuwait’s Association of Retired Officers represented by Maj. Gen. Ret. Faisal M. Al Jazzaf, Chairman and Maj. Gen. Ret. Nader Shaaban, Vice Chairman, to further strengthen its cooperation and commitment to supporting the Association’s members and their families.

The MoU will provide members with access to travel-related benefits and convenient travel options across Jazeera Airways’ growing network, while establishing a framework for broader cooperation and future initiatives.

This partnership is aimed at recognizing the many years of service and contribution made by retired officers from Kuwait’s Armed Forces, Ministry of Interior, Kuwait National Guard and Kuwait Fire Force to the country.

As a Kuwaiti airline, Jazeera Airways is proud to work with national institutions to create meaningful benefits for the communities they serve and recognize those who have dedicated their careers to serving Kuwait
